findings.title: The recurring invariant audit definition can produce false-green verification
findings.evidence: Five required cargo-test selectors exit successfully while executing zero tests, and the catalog-mutation registry predates current expression-index and physical-migration publication routes.
findings.present_friction: Every run must rediscover live replacement tests manually or risk reporting proof that did not execute; current mutation routes can also be omitted from the invariant registry.
findings.trigger: Before the next invariant-preservation audit execution.
